subject: MAP: throughput acceptance & unit-econ readout for FinClear POC
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Briggs <alex.briggs@finclear.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-02 09:12 PDT
Subject: MAP kickoff + throughput eval plan (FinClear POC)

Alex — attaching the updated MAP and the test plan we ran yesterday. High level: we focused the POC on sustained throughput and unit economics for your high-frequency reconciliation endpoint. Summary below, full results attached. Please review and confirm acceptance criteria so we can lock timelines.

Quick summary (executive):
- Target workload: Avg request -> 120 prompt tokens / 80 gen tokens (200 total).
- Key goals in MAP: sustained QPS at p95 latency <= 300ms, TTFT <= 40ms, and unit cost ceiling <= $12 per 1M tokens delivered (infra cost basis).
- Models benchmarked: rw-13b-q4 (primary candidate), rw-70b-q8 (fallback for complex reconciliation).

Benchmarks (representative):
- rw-13b-q4: sustained tokens/sec (steady-state) = 118,000 tokens/sec; derived sustained QPS = 590 QPS (200 tokens/req) while holding p95 latency = 285ms; median TTFT = 22ms; p95 tail latency (end-to-end) = 180ms; concurrency tested up to 480 streams without degrading p95 beyond MAP goal.
- rw-70b-q8: sustained tokens/sec = 44,500 tokens/sec; derived sustained QPS = 222 QPS (200 tokens/req); median TTFT = 48ms; p95 tail = 410ms; concurrency tested up to 220 streams.

Unit economics (infra-only, pre-margin):
- rw-13b-q4: baseline infra cost = $7.20 per 1M tokens. With batching & prefix caching (our recommendations) we estimate effective cost = $4.70 per 1M tokens (≈35% reduction).
- rw-70b-q8: baseline infra cost = $18.80 per 1M tokens; optimized cost ≈ $12.20 per 1M tokens (≈35% reduction).

Action items / asks:
1) Please confirm that the MAP acceptance criteria below match your procurement needs.
2) Sign off on the two-week sustained run (we recommend 14 days at your production traffic profile) to finalize economics and SLA commits.
3) Confirm target close date (we proposed Oct 20 in the MAP).

MAP acceptance criteria (proposed):
- Sustained QPS: >= 560 QPS observed for 14 consecutive days with average 200 tokens/req.
- p95 latency <= 300ms for rw-13b-q4; p99 <= 600ms.
- TTFT median <= 40ms.
- Availability >= 99.9% across the run.
- Unit infra cost <= $10 per 1M tokens (final negotiated rate to be in contract).

I've attached the redwood_map_v2.pdf and the raw CSV of the run for your team. Priya, Markus — FYI and feel free to adjust cost columns if finance wants different overhead assumptions.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0142

Attachments: redwood_map_v2.pdf (MAP), finclear_bench_results.csv (raw time-series), pricing_breakdown_v3.xlsx (cost model)
From: Alex Briggs <alex.briggs@finclear.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops+dev@finclear.com
Date: 2027-10-03 11:04 EDT
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + throughput eval plan (FinClear POC)

Thanks Irene — appreciate the concise summary. We ran a quick internal sanity pass this morning on our side and attached our annotated CSV with a few questions. Top-level reactions:

- The rw-13b-q4 numbers look promising; our production distribution has some >400-token responses for edge cases (long diffs). Can you share how p95 behaves when response tokens jump to 400?
- We need clarity on warm-cache vs cold-cache numbers. Our traffic pattern includes a mix of unique IDs (low cache hit) and many repeated prefixes (higher hit rate). Can you show both profiles?

We attached finclear_bench_results.csv (annotated) and added a short list of questions in the comments. Primary blocker for procurement is the verified sustained run at our real production mix. If Redwood can run the 14-day sustained test against our representative trace (we'll provide anonymized logs), procurement is comfortable moving to contract subject to final pricing.

Proposed close target remains Oct 20, but procurement wants visibility two business days before for final DocuSign prep.

— Alex
Alex Briggs
Head of Platform Engineering | FinClear
alex.briggs@finclear.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Briggs <alex.briggs@finclear.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-04 08:26 PDT
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + throughput eval plan (FinClear POC)

Alex — thanks for the notes and the annotated CSV. I pulled the tail analysis you asked for and added a split for warm-cache vs cold-cache from our instrumented run. Key points pasted below; full tables are in pricing_breakdown_v3.xlsx.

Tail behavior (rw-13b-q4):
- 200-token baseline: p95 = 285ms (matches Irene's note), p99 = 420ms.
- 400-token edge responses: p95 = 520ms, p99 = 820ms. These edge responses are <5% of total requests in your trace sample.
- Warm-cache (prefix hit) effect: ~38% reduction in token generation time (effective tokens/sec increased by 52k in that subset).
- Cold-cache: saw a TTFT increase of ~18ms median vs warm-cache.

Sustained-run plan we propose:
- Redwood runs the 14-day sustained run using your anonymized trace with native split (unique vs repeated prefixes). We'll run it across our Dedicated pool and provide daily dashboards.
- Acceptance is based on the 14-day aggregate meeting the MAP acceptance criteria; exceptions for <1% outliers above p95 will be allowed if tied to identifiable long-response cases we can mitigate with routing (fallback to rw-70b for complex requests).

Unit-econ update (after trace-weighting):
- Weighted effective tokens/sec for rw-13b-q4 = 104,000 tokens/sec -> weighted sustained QPS ≈ 520 QPS (200 tokens/req average).
- Weighted effective cost after caching & batching = $5.20 per 1M tokens. With our standard margin + SRE overhead, final customer price target = $9.50 per 1M tokens (volume tiers apply).

Next steps:
1) Alex — please upload anonymized traffic dump to the Drive link. We will start the 14-day run within 24 hours of receipt.
2) Irene — can you draft the short amendment that confirms finish criteria and the DocuSign schedule? Procurement wants a 48-hour window prior to Oct 20.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Briggs <alex.briggs@finclear.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-05 09:18 EDT
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + throughput eval plan (FinClear POC)

Thanks Priya — we uploaded three anonymized traces to the Drive folder (links in the CSV comments). We're happy with the proposed acceptance guardrails (allow small outliers tied to long responses and fallback routing). Please proceed with the 14-day run starting Monday (Oct 5).

On price: procurement will accept $9.50 per 1M tokens if we get the documented 14-day run and the SLA targets. We will still want a clear abort condition if availability or p95 materially exceeds targets.

We confirm DocuSign window: Oct 18 (EOD) to prepare for Oct 20 close.

— Alex
